senses.en_definition: The part of a human or animal body above the neck or at the front, containing the eyes, mouth and ears; the head.
The top, front or beginning of something; its head.
The leader or person in charge of a group, organization, country or household.
The mind or the ability to think, reason and understand.
A person, considered as a unit when counting people or calculating charges.

messages.en: My head hurts. I'm sitting tonight's game out. Gonna lie down for a bit.
Oh, just get some rest for now. Message me when you're feeling better.
He bumped his head on the table earlier, but he's okay now.
Oh, no wonder he was so quiet earlier.
He called me a bastard in the group chat earlier.
That's awful. Save a screenshot first, and don't reply while you're angry.
Don't betray my trust, okay? This stays between us.
Don't worry, I won't tell anyone.
